concept.hr: Signali s dvaju putova zbrajaju se: fazna razlika ih pojačava ili poništava
concept.en: Signals from two paths add up; their phase difference makes them grow or cancel

summary.hr: Izravni i reflektirani signal zbrajaju se u prijamniku. Klizači mijenjaju faznu razliku i jakost refleksije; zbroj je pojačan, oslabljen ili poništen.
summary.en: The direct and a reflected signal add up at the receiver. Sliders set their phase difference and the reflection's strength; the sum grows, shrinks or cancels.

what.hr: Aplet applet_interferenz.html (fazni pomak dvaju signala i njihov zbroj) i tekst odjeljka o višestaznom širenju (50ohm.de, hrvatski prijevod)
what.en: The applet applet_interferenz.html (two signals shifted in phase, and their sum) and the text of the multipath propagation section (50ohm.de, Croatian translation)

changes.hr: Prilagođen simdeck kitu i nacrtan bez vanjskih biblioteka, preveden na engleski, dodani klizač jakosti refleksije, oznaka fazne razlike i amplituda zbroja
changes.en: Adapted to the simdeck kit and drawn without outside libraries, translated into English, a slider for the reflection's strength, a phase-difference marker and the sum's amplitude added
